name: Michelle Montague
summary: An unbeaten New Zealand bantamweight from ATT (8-0, age 33), 2-0 in the UFC with decisions over Luana Carolina and Mayra Bueno Silva. Six of her eight wins are submissions.

how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Both UFC wins went the distance.

concerns: UFC opponents have survived her grappling
keys_to_beat: Stuff her takedowns and win at range
